---
title: "Brain CD45 and HG cells: NicheNet"
output: html_document
---

Brain CD45+ immune cells and high granularity (HG) cells from PBS- and AEC-treated mice (GEO: GSE301590).

NicheNet: ligands from mast cells that explain the changes in Il4 Th2 cells between AEC and PBS.
Starts from `data/scrna/Cd45_HG.rds`, saved by `02_merge_CD45_HG.Rmd`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Load the packages
```{r Load the Packages}
library(Seurat)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(Matrix)
library(nichenetr)
library(tidyverse)

for (d in c("data/scrna", "results/Brain_Cd45_HG/Targeted_genes", "results/Brain_Cd45_HG/Trajectory", "results/Brain_Cd45_HG/NicheNet", "results/Brain_Cd45_HG/tradeseq_input")) {
  dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}
```

# NicheNet
#### Load the database
```{r Load the dataBase}
DATA <- readRDS("data/scrna/Cd45_HG.rds")
DATA <- SetIdent(DATA, value = "Subtypes2")

lr_network = readRDS(url("https://zenodo.org/record/7074291/files/lr_network_mouse_21122021.rds"))
ligand_target_matrix = readRDS(url("https://zenodo.org/record/7074291/files/ligand_target_matrix_nsga2r_final_mouse.rds"))
weighted_networks = readRDS(url("https://zenodo.org/record/7074291/files/weighted_networks_nsga2r_final_mouse.rds"))

lr_network = lr_network %>% distinct(from, to)
head(lr_network)
ligand_target_matrix[1:5,1:5] # target genes in rows, ligands in columns
```

```{r NicheNet Mast cells to Il4 Th2 cells}
nichenet_output = nichenet_seuratobj_aggregate(
  seurat_obj = DATA,
  receiver = "Il4 Th2 Cells",
  condition_colname = "Condition", condition_oi = "AEC", condition_reference = "PBS",
  sender = "Mast Cells",
  ligand_target_matrix = ligand_target_matrix,
  lr_network = lr_network,
  weighted_networks = weighted_networks, top_n_ligands = 100,cutoff_visualization= 0.1)

write.csv(nichenet_output$ligand_activities, "results/Brain_Cd45_HG/NicheNet/NicheNet_Mast_Il4Tcell_ligand_activities.csv", row.names = FALSE)

pdf(file = "results/Brain_Cd45_HG/NicheNet/NicheNet_Mast_Il4Tcell.pdf", width = 15, height =12)
nichenet_output$ligand_activity_target_heatmap
nichenet_output$ligand_target_heatmap
nichenet_output$ligand_receptor_heatmap
dev.off()
```

#### Which cell types express the top ligands
```{r}
avg_expression_ligands = AggregateExpression(DATA, features = nichenet_output$top_ligands)
sender_ligand_assignment = avg_expression_ligands$RNA %>% apply(1, function(ligand_expression){
  ligand_expression > (ligand_expression %>% mean() + ligand_expression %>% sd())
  }) %>% t()
sender_ligand_assignment = sender_ligand_assignment %>% apply(2, function(x){x[x == TRUE]}) %>% purrr::keep(function(x){length(x) > 0})
names(sender_ligand_assignment)
```

```{r}
VlnPlot(DATA %>% subset(idents = "Monocyte 5"), features =  "Osm", group.by = "Condition")
DotPlot(DATA %>% subset(idents = "Monocyte 5"), features =  nichenet_output$top_ligands %>% rev(), split.by = "Condition") + coord_flip()
VlnPlot(DATA %>% subset(idents = "Il4 Th2 Cells"), features =  c("Ivns1abp","Maf"), group.by = "Condition")
VlnPlot(DATA %>% subset(idents = "Reactive Microglia"), features =  "Pim1" , split.by = "Condition") + coord_flip()
```
